description: Every agent ecosystem the harvester has read, as one figure: each chain with its agents and handshake-ready count, the work surfaces (n8n, MCP, A2A cards), the TEE claims, and the chains recorded unscanned with the reason. Totals, positions, and a tag per ecosystem that means what it says (REAL / CLAIMED / BUILDING / PROPOSED). Read this to know where agents are before you hire or register.
name: taifoon_landscape
